new_events.summary: AP reported the released vote count for the October 27 election: Netanyahu-aligned bloc 53 seats, Eisenkot opposition bloc 48, Arab-led parties 19. Neither bloc holds 61 seats; formal certification/submission to president expected November 4. Result reporting is not formation of government or proof of fraud.

new_events.summary: AP reported US cancelled customary G20 foreign-minister group photo in Atlanta after European diplomats objected to appearance with Russia's Lavrov. The G20 ministerial meeting proceeded; this is diplomatic disagreement, not cancellation of G20 or a military commitment on Iran.

existing_event_updates.summary: Guardian interviewed Taiz governor Nabil Shamsan: he estimates minimum 35,000 cubic metres/day water demand versus at most 1,000 entering, 120 suspended health centres, up to 1,800 dialysis patients needing supplies, 64 deaths and 173 injuries Aug–Oct20, and 6,400 newly displaced families. Governor estimates and attribution remain source-specific; do not add 64 to existing incident deaths or equate displaced families with individuals. Houthi leader denies a siege; Human Rights Watch describes blocked access.

geospatial.uncertainty_note: City-scale humanitarian conditions; no specific roadblock or strike coordinate established.

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters and UKMTO describe two explosive devices attached from small craft to tanker port side about 25 NM northeast of Khasab, fire extinguished, crew safe, voyage resumed; three security sources identify Panama-flagged Louise 1. Already recorded in accepted packet sequence 37. No new attack, attribution or point-coordinate promotion; additional source detail only.

Iranian official rejected Sunday draft; Tehran seeks blockade/sanctions relief first and Washington wants nuclear issues addressed at outset. Already accepted in sequence 37.
